verdict.rationale: First-party docs state the core workflow directly: describe what you want in plain language, and Claude Code plans the approach, writes code across multiple files, and verifies it (docs-2, docs-28, docs-51, docs-52). Bug-to-PR and issue-to-feature flows are also documented (docs-11, docs-16, docs-30), and daily hands-on users confirm real multi-file feature work (comm-16, comm-20). Some users report wrong edits and unreliable self-verification (comm-16, comm-19), but these are reliability complaints rather than concrete evidence the capability doesn't exist. Missing for 10: consistent independent corroboration of reliable output quality, and evidence that the self-verification step actually catches errors. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: quality trimmed q8 -> q7. Three concrete negative hands-on reports are cited (comm-16 self-verification failure, comm-19 '100% failure rate', comm-20 capability regression); q8 did not reflect their weight, and the same-bar competitor cell (devin, pilot-memo spot-read 10) sits at full q7 on milder caveats. Tier kept: daily hands-on users also confirm real multi-file delivery, so the sonnet-5 disputed 0.3x baseline was the worse error per the adopted memo's adjudication. Anthropic-affiliation governance, README §9.]
